name: date-deschise
description: Explore 30+ Romanian open datasets (companies, budgets, procurement, elections, energy, air quality, INS and Eurostat statistics) with DuckDB SQL over public HTTPS, and turn the answers into professional, sourced reports with duckdb-wasm.

interface.longDescription: Ask questions of Romania's public data and get answers you can check. Date deschise publishes 30+ datasets as sorted Parquet plus one DuckLake catalog on a public bucket: the company register, public budget execution, procurement, elections, the power grid, exchange rates, air quality, INS TEMPO and Eurostat statistics, and more. This plugin teaches the agent the route — read the dataset's own page, query it with DuckDB over plain HTTPS (no API key, no account), scan rather than sample, and cite the dataset, licence, SQL and as-of date behind every number. When an answer has more than a handful of numbers, it builds a polished, self-contained HTML report with charts, a query link behind every figure, CSV/JSON downloads, and optional live refresh through duckdb-wasm.
defaultPrompt: How has the EUR/RON exchange rate moved since 2015? Build me a report.
Which Romanian public institutions spent the most last year?
What datasets do you have about air quality in Bucharest?
